info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, swellAngle, radians, Ypos, mapXPos, survivorDelay, thisMember, startMember, Xvel, cableGuy, survivorState, ThisWidth, thisHalfHeight, grabCount, distToHQ, frameDir, pullCount, loopX, loopWidth, COPTER, ship, claw, blackCopter, stolenCountglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gCableItem, gCableLength, gRescueCount, gRescuedList, gScore, gXVelChangeon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  startMember = this.memberNum  claw = sprite(80)  COPTER = sprite(4)  blackCopter = sprite(79)  ship = sprite(59)  thisMember = startMember  this.member = member(thisMember, "Gfx")  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  this.locZ = 103  Xvel = 0  mapXPos = Xpos - 256 - 64  survivorDelay = 0  swellAngle = 0  cableGuy = sprite(6)  survivorState = #ONGROUND  ThisWidth = this.width  thisHalfHeight = this.height / 2  grabCount = 0  distToHQ = 0  frameDir = 1  pullCount = 0  stolenCount = 0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case survivorState of      #ONGROUND:        Xpos = Xpos + (gXVel + gXOffset)        if Xpos > loopX then          Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth        end if        if Xpos < -loopX then          Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth        end if        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos        diffX = abs(this.locH - cableGuy.locH)        diffY = abs(this.locV - cableGuy.locV)        if (diffX < 70) and (diffY < 100) then          if (diffX < ThisWidth) and (diffY < thisHalfHeight) then            grabCount = grabCount + 1            if grabCount >= 2 then              if (gCableItem = 0) and (gCableLength >= 50) then                survivorState = #GRABBED                gCableItem = -1              end if            end if          else            grabCount = 0          end if        end if      #GRABBED:        Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset        if Xpos > loopX then          Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth        end if        if Xpos < -loopX then          Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth        end if        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos        if soundBusy(4) = 0 then          puppetSound(4, member(72, "Sfx"))        end if        xDiff = float(COPTER.locH - gXVel - this.locH)        yDiff = float(COPTER.locV + COPTER.Yvel - this.locV)        distToCopter = sqrt((xDiff * xDiff) + (yDiff * yDiff))        toCopterVector = this.loc - COPTER.loc + point(-gXVel, COPTER.Yvel)        if distToCopter > gCableLength then          pullVector = toCopterVector / float(distToCopter) * (distToCopter - gCableLength)          gXVelChange = gXVelChange - pullVector.locH          COPTER.Yvel = COPTER.Yvel + pullVector.locV          cableGuy.cableState = #GODOWN          if pullVector.locV > 0 then            Ypos = Ypos - 0.05            pullCount = pullCount + 1          end if        end if        toCableGuyVector = this.loc - (cableGuy.loc + point(cableGuy.Xvel, cableGuy.Yvel))        pullVector = toCableGuyVector        cableGuy.Xvel = cableGuy.Xvel + pullVector.locH        cableGuy.Yvel = cableGuy.Yvel + pullVector.locV        if pullCount > 40 then          survivorState = #ONCABLE          this.rotation = 30          gCableItem = 2          puppetSound(4, member(73, "Sfx"))        end if      #ONCABLE:        cableGuy.cableState = #GODOWN        this.loc = cableGuy.loc        diffX = abs(this.locH - claw.locH)        diffY = abs(this.locV - claw.locV)        if (diffX < 10) and (diffY < 10) and (gCableItem = 2) then          survivorState = #ONCLAW          gCableItem = 0          blackCopter.gotWarHead = 1          puppetSound(4, member(76, "Sfx"))        end if        diffX = abs(this.locH - ship.locH)        diffY = abs(this.locV - ship.locV)        if (diffX < 100) and (diffY < 40) then          gCableItem = 0          survivorState = #HOME          gScore = gScore + 500          puppetSound(3, member(8, "Sfx"))          gRescuedList.add(this)          gRescueCount = gRescueCount + 1        end if      #HOME:        this.locH = -1000        this.locV = -1000      #ONCLAW:        stolenCount = stolenCount + 1        this.loc = claw.loc + point(0, 0)        diffX = abs(this.locH - cableGuy.locH)        diffY = abs(this.locV - cableGuy.locV)        if stolenCount > 30 then          if (diffX < 70) and (diffY < 100) then            if (diffX < ThisWidth) and (diffY < thisHalfHeight) then              if (gCableItem = 0) and (gCableLength >= 50) then                survivorState = #ONCABLE                gCableItem = 1                puppetSound(4, member(77, "Sfx"))                blackCopter.gotWarHead = 0              end if            end if          end if        end if    end case  end ifend
